title: Sorcerer With A Minigun (v42)
description: Hurl fireballs, summon skeletal minions, and battle through waves of enemies in this dark fantasy arena. Full HP restored at start of each wave.
prompt:
make the following changes:

1. add a new feature to the game for equipping a amulet. put a box down in the bottom in the stats bar about the size of a icon. The player can find random amulets when destroying stone blocks, make the chance of finding one about 1 out of 50. These amulets will have random power for example, health regeneration 5 per second, double damage, extra skeleton spawn, make up a few other random ones that help the player. When the player find a new amulet and they collect it, pause the game and show two dialog boxes, one dialog box shows their current amulet, the second one shows the one they just collected, they can choose to equip it or discard it. Create icons for each amulet related to one of the power-up it ads. Some amulets can give 2 powers, others only one.
